shipReasons: No critical defect: every FFX chapter played by real keys reaches its results screen with no page error; no crash, lock or lost progress.

The key risk is clear: after real key presses in Ch II, III, X and XVIII the advisor card appears within one frame, with long tasks and frame gaps equal to or lower than live (first N press worst gap 150-175 ms on the candidate against 164-345 ms on live).

Better than live: the Ch XVIII line wins debug-auto seeds 1-3 (live loses 3 of 3), Ch X wins 3 of 3 (live 2 of 3), Ch IX 3 of 3 (live 2 of 3); the Cancel and Talk menus match the game and passed on real keys at three sizes.
The only FAIL (CHK-027 motion, FOC3945-01) is the same on live and sits in presenter code this change does not touch: disclosed, not a regression.
FFX-2 sources are byte-identical to live and Ch IV, V and VI still play.
